[quote=the_crystalline_empire;60679239][b]September 22, 2025: Save the World First, Orthodoxy Second.[/b]

The ultimatum by the USO shook the government of Thýven, nuclear weapons aimed now at Thývens shores was unthinkable, and indeed shook even the most loyal Mendenavist. Yet it seemed to most that the patriarch was set upon his track.

As a result a fracture would appear in the hours following the ultimatum as loyal Mendenavists sought quickly a resolution to the matter, attempting to rapidly pass legislation to revoke the order, however, hardliners proved a major block on any revocation of the order, utilising the ideal of Patriarchal Infallibility to defend the actions of the patriarch.

In the meantime the nobility of Thýven, fed up with the shenanigans of the church would move to back an emergency coalition formed by the Doge of the Free Republic of Knygta and Deyn, Albus Capricorn, who had vowed to end the blockade within 24 hours, and dethrone the patriarch.

However the promise came with a caveat, the formation of a neutral emergency government under the governance of solely the Gøsfodde with Capricorn as the temporary head of state, something which few nobles were willing to accept, fearing that the more liberal Capricorn would attempt to use his Republic's wealth to influence the trajectory of the government.

Unable to verbally command the legislature, Capricorn thus moved to assert his power physically, ordering the Merchant Navy of the Free Republic of Knygta and Deyn to be raised to full combat mode with plans to face the blockade, hoping to break it internally.

While to some this was a laughable attempt to gain legitimacy under a heavily centralised Mendenavist government, it became clear that Capricorn was serious in his threats as the Navy of the Republic quickly made its way to the rear of the blockade, armed and ready to fire. Furthermore was the threat of Knygta and Deyn using its own rocket arsenal and SRBM arsenal against Thýven itself to restore order.

Thus, as the navy made its appearance on the blockade, the Gøsfodde would assemble under the guise of preventing a potentially destabilising civil war, led by Piter Drømm a series of declarations were made.

[list]
1. The Mendenavist government is stripped of its powers under the 1865 constitution
2. The Patriarchate will be stripped of legislative and executive powers effective immediately.
3. The armed forces of Thýven will be temporarily recalled from all international positions.
4. An emergency government will be formed under the leadership of the Gøsfodde, acting as executive and legislative.
[/list]

With the orders being issued and promulgated, the government of Thýven would signal internationally that it would be lifting the blockade for The stability and freedom of Erene, along with a two week period of full withdrawal of all armed forces from centres of conflict in the White Strait and the Baliwick Sea.
